functional.req: The system shall provide a User Login page with a username field and a masked password field, and shall block every other page until the user has signed in. A logout option shall end the session.
functional.source: Technical Spec - Web interface: User login page
functional.design: AuthController (loginForm, login, logout); login.ejs; requireLogin gate in server.js
functional.note: Sign-in gate, masked password and logout work. Checking credentials against the lpa_users table with hashed passwords is scheduled for ICTPRG537 (security).

functional.req: The system shall provide a Main Home page with a global header, navigation and footer, showing a summary of the business: number of stock items, low-stock and out-of-stock counts, number of invoices and total sales.
functional.source: Technical Spec - Web interface: Main home page

functional.req: The system shall list all stock items showing stock ID (SKU), name, category, price, on-hand quantity and status (In / Low / Out of stock).
functional.source: Technical Spec - Stock management page; lpa_stock table

functional.req: The system shall let staff search stock by product name, brand, SKU or category.
The system shall let staff add a new stock item (name, brand, SKU, category, price, quantity, status, description) and save it.
functional.source: Technical Spec - Stock management page (add / save)

functional.req: The system shall let staff edit an existing stock item and save or close without saving.
functional.source: Technical Spec - Stock management page (edit / save / close)
functional.design: ProductController.editForm + update (PUT); products/edit.ejs; Close link on detail page

functional.req: Each stock item shall have a status of enabled (active) or disabled.
The system shall let staff delete a stock item.
The system shall let staff adjust stock on hand (add, remove or reconcile to a counted total) with a reason, and the on-hand quantity shall never go below zero.
functional.source: Client reference app (LPA stock adjustment); data integrity

functional.req: Every stock adjustment shall be recorded in an audit history showing who made it, the item, the operation, the reason, the quantity before and after, and the time.
functional.design: StockLedger model; stock/ledger.ejs; user read from session
functional.note: Fixed during validation: the ledger had recorded a fixed name and no time for new entries; it now records the signed-in user and the time.

functional.req: The system shall provide a Sales and Invoicing page where staff can search invoices and see the results listed by Date, Client and Amount with a total of the amounts shown.
functional.source: Technical Spec - Web interface: Sales and Invoicing page

functional.req: The system shall keep client records with client ID, first name, last name, address, phone and status, and let staff search them.
functional.note: Fixed during validation: the address field was missing; added to the model, the search and the clients table.

functional.req: Each invoice shall reference an existing client by client ID, and carry the client's name and address.
functional.note: Fixed during validation: invoices stored a free-text client name with no link to the client record; they now reference the client ID and take the name/address from the Client model.

functional.req: Invoices shall record their line items (stock ID, name, quantity, price, line amount).
functional.design: Planned: invoice_items table + Invoice detail view
functional.note: Scheduled with the database block (ICTDBS507), where the lpa_invoice_items table is created.

functional.req: The system shall store user accounts (username, hashed password, first/last name, user group) and use the user group to control access.
functional.design: Planned: users table + auth middleware + roles

functional.req: All business data (stock, clients, invoices, invoice items, users) shall be held in a centralised MySQL database (lpa_ecomms) shared by the web, mobile and desktop interfaces.
functional.source: Technical Spec - Create centralised database; lpa_ecomms.sql
functional.design: Models are the single data-access layer, so moving from in-memory arrays to MySQL changes only the Models
functional.note: Prototype uses in-memory models with the same fields as the lpa_ecomms tables. Migration scheduled for ICTDBS507; ERD below is the validated target design.

functional.req: An Android application shall present the LPA interface using the Android WebView library, showing a splash screen and a delay before loading the main WebView activity.
functional.note: Built and signed as an APK. On-device evidence screenshots still to be captured.

functional.req: A desktop application (Java GUI: main window with menu, stock, sales and user frames) shall give staff access to the same data.
functional.design: Planned: Java Swing app reading the shared MySQL database

functional.req: The website shall include mashups that combine data from multiple external services with LPA's own data.
functional.design: MashupController: Store Locator (OSM + Open-Meteo + stores) and International Pricing (catalogue + FX rates)

functional.req: Users shall be able to personalise the interface (light/dark theme and accent colour) and the choice shall be remembered.
The interface shall include graphics and multimedia appropriate to the business (product images, icons, a promotional video).
functional.design: Product icons; promo video on home page

functional.req: Data-entry forms shall validate input on the client side and show clear error messages before submission.
Stock data shall be available as JSON (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) so other interfaces and tools can use the same data.
functional.source: ICTPRG556 (four HTTP verbs); shared data for mobile/desktop
functional.design: ProductController returns JSON when the client asks for application/json

nonfunctional.req: Professional, consistent look and design: one brand palette, typography and layout across all pages; mobile-first and usable on phone and desktop widths.
nonfunctional.evidence: UI Design Plan (Phase 4); all screens share header, bottom navigation and design tokens.

nonfunctional.req: Form fields have labels, search boxes have aria-labels, text meets contrast in light and dark themes.
nonfunctional.evidence: login.ejs / _form.ejs labels; aria-label on search inputs; dark theme contrast tokens.

nonfunctional.req: Modular design for easier future extension: Models, Views, Controllers and routes kept separate (MVC).
Pages render server-side and respond in under 500 ms on the development machine.
Protected pages require sign-in; session cookies are HttpOnly; user input is HTML-escaped when shown.
nonfunctional.evidence: requireLogin gate; HttpOnly cookies; EJS <%= %> escaping. Hashed passwords, roles and injection-safe SQL come in ICTPRG537 / ICTDBS507.

nonfunctional.req: The application should be deployable to a hosted server for 24 x 7 availability.
nonfunctional.evidence: Runs on any Node.js host (no OS-specific code). Hosting is out of scope for the prototype; to confirm with supervisor.

nonfunctional.req: Works in at least two browsers and on at least two devices.
nonfunctional.evidence: Chromium + Android WebView verified. Second desktop browser (Edge/Firefox) test scheduled with ICTWEB514.

nonfunctional.req: All source code is kept under Git with a remote on GitHub.
Stock on hand can never be negative and every invoice must point to an existing client.
nonfunctional.evidence: Product.adjust floors at 0; Invoice -> Client lookup.
